name: recent-life
description: Recent daily life for an assistant: travel, places stayed, exercise, sleep, steps, illness and notes. It does not serve medicines, laboratory results, conditions, blood pressure, heart rate, documents or hourly location tracks. The reader sets the time window, usually the last seven days. The type list is the boundary, because most of these types are Sensitive. v2 named the types under the taxonomy of card 147; v3 named notes record.edge (card 191); v4 names the trip and illness types with their third segment (card 196); v5 names exercise by the prefix activity.exercise-session., every vendor's leaf (cards 193 and 195).
